headline: Backup Power for Smith County Homes
summary: Smith County has a high outlook. It sees a long outage of 12 hours or more about once every 4 years based on 8 years of records since 2018. In June 2024, 56% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 47 hours. In January 2023, 33% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 58 hours. For a home with gas heat and a larger footprint, one Core lasts about 13 hours in August. One Core lasts about 29 hours in February. Two Cores last about 21 hours in August. Two Cores cover 81% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
